Neither set extracts any row of Table 5.5-1 (M1 4,000 mm diameter, 19,800 mm RoC, 420 mm thickness, 9,030 mm spacing; M2 450 mm, -1,953 mm, 100 mm, 9,080 mm; M3 680 mm, -2,168 mm, 100 mm; M3 coating 'Varies'), which is the most quantitatively valuable content on the page.
